name: claudemy
description: An open-source alternative to Udemy and Coursera: give Claude a topic, it researches the web and builds a course of 2-minute two-host audio lessons with cited sources and one small practice each.

elevenlabs_api_key.title: ElevenLabs API key
elevenlabs_api_key.description: Optional. Renders lessons with two natural ElevenLabs voices. Leave empty to use the free built-in Windows voices.
